description.en: In response to Taiwan’s frequent typhoons and aging population, this project designs a rehabilitation clinic and shelter that expands its architectural space during severe flooding.
description.zh: 因應台灣台灣常受颱風侵襲以及老年化的議題，設計一棟當水災來臨時可延伸出建築空間的復健診所暨收容中心。

description.en: By integrating a kindergarten and residential program, the design utilizes the site’s 2-meter terrain shift to weave dynamic social spaces and seamlessly bridge the building with its surrounding environment.
description.zh: 結合幼兒園與住宅功能，利用2m高差地形創造多樣化交流空間、並利用建築功能串聯周遭場域。
